note: Synthetic cards for the Laya admission-controller probe (Gate 6, phase B1). Hand-written, not derived from any corpus, so this file is safe to read anywhere. 'expected' is MY judgement of the right action, not ground truth: cases where the right answer is genuinely unclear carry expected: null and are reported but not scored.

cases.question: What is the sprocket tolerance at governed speed?
cases.card: Calibration note, revision 9: with the turbine governing at 3000 revolutions the sprocket tolerance is 0.02 millimetres.
cases.why: The card states the answer; anything shorter risks losing the number.

cases.question: What is the sprocket tolerance at governed speed?
cases.card: Turbine service manual, 240 pages: assembly sequence, lubrication schedule, alignment procedure, tolerance tables for the sprocket, control-loop gains, and a fault index.
cases.why: The answer is somewhere inside, but expanding a 240-page manual costs more context than the description it replaces.

cases.question: What is the sprocket tolerance at governed speed?
cases.card: Index of documents that mention the Markhausen retrofit: 14 entries with titles and dates.
cases.why: It says where to look, not what the answer is; the title line is the whole value.

cases.question: What is the sprocket tolerance at governed speed?
cases.card: Canteen menu for the week beginning Monday: soup, two mains, one vegetarian option.
cases.why: No bearing on the question; including it costs context and buys nothing.

cases.question: Is the corpus mounted read-only?
cases.card: Mount options recorded for the corpus: ro,noatime.
cases.why: Two tokens that answer the question completely.

cases.question: Which team owns the export service?

cases.why: The ownership answer is in the body.

cases.question: Which team owns the export service?
cases.card: Organisation chart revision 9: every team, its remit and its lead, 40 rows.
cases.why: A long list whose shape is more useful than its contents.

cases.question: How many documents does the value set contain, and how many were cited?
cases.card: Enrichment plan summary: 143 documents considered, 13 of them cited by an answer.
cases.why: The two numbers are the answer.

cases.question: How many documents does the value set contain, and how many were cited?
cases.card: Enrichment plan, header row: rank, source, served, cited, provenance.
cases.why: The header proves the plan exists; the counts are elsewhere and the header cannot supply them.

cases.question: What does the calibration procedure require before measurement?
cases.card: Procedure step 4: warm the turbine for 20 minutes before taking any measurement.

cases.question: What does the calibration procedure require before measurement?
cases.card: Glossary: 'warm-up' - see the calibration procedure, step 4.
cases.why: A cross-reference; expanding it yields a pointer, not the requirement.

cases.question: Who wrote this document?
cases.card: Document metadata: title, date, revision; no author field is present.
cases.why: It answers the question only by absence, which the model can report without the card.

cases.question: What tolerance applies to the sprocket?
cases.card: Two tolerances appear in the record: 0.02 millimetres in revision 9 and 0.05 millimetres in revision 7. Which governs is not stated here.
cases.why: Resolving it needs the change history, which the controller cannot see; expanding and summarising are both defensible, so this case is reported and not scored.

cases.question: Which library versions are vendored?
cases.card: Third-party notice: 412 libraries with licence names, no version strings, followed by the full text of four licences.
cases.why: The card is long and the question is only partly answerable from it - a summary may be enough or may drop the only useful line, and which one the model does is exactly what this probe is measuring rather than deciding.
